components.remaining: (0) Session 11: (a) the H_infinity completeness theorem is for the handbook's calculus; Barwise names no rule, and Karp's or Lopez-Escobar's calculus (thm:p02-karp-completeness, cited) is not reproduced: Karp 1964 and Lopez-Escobar 1965 are not held; the Lopez-Escobar open-access copy (Fund. Math. 57, IMPAN/matwbn) returned HTTP 403 and was not read. (b) Session 12: H with the two rules under the narrower 4.11 proviso and the unrenamed quantifier axioms (Barwise's p. 34 convention) is proved not complete (thm:p02-w02c-p02-003-h-flat). Open: whether that system becomes complete when instances of schema (3) formed after renaming bound variables (the gloss of def:p02-w02-p02-005-bw-substitution) are added; the annex argument does not cover them (warning def:p02-w02c-p02-003-h-flat-limit). (1) Barwise p. 16 G2 claim: thm:p02-w02c-p02-003-integers-second now proves the claim without the D2/D3 hypotheses (selected formula Prv^sharp, D1-D3 proved) and with an explicit primitive recursive enumeration of T^sharp; computable enumerability in the Turing-machine sense still passes through the cited thm:p04-tm-partial-recursive (Kleene 1952; P4-owned, partial recursive => Turing computable); its proof is not written in the handbook (theories-boundary item 3). D2/D3 for the arbitrary representative of def:fixed-proof-predicate are not provable in general (thm:p02-w02c-p02-003-arbitrary-representative), so the claim is proved with the selected formula, as sec:second-incompleteness-01 does for PA. (2) Axiom 0 of Keisler is Church's list, not held and not compared; the theorems are proved for the list (0a)-(0g) (warning kq-axiom-zero). (3) Keisler Corollary 2.10 second part (r.e. of valid sentences) and the converse of 2.9 are not stated. (4) Szmielew decidability of abelian groups and undecidability of groups: blocked_source (Szmielew 1955 not held; TMR 1953 ACQ-2026-10-0529). (5) Barwise 1974 Thm 4.1 inputs: blocked_source (Makowsky-Shelah-Stavi 1976, Barwise L_HYP interpolation, Barwise 1975 not held). (6) thm:representability (restoration capture, cited) is no longer used by integers-second; it is still used by def:fixed-proof-predicate and by the failure-case lemma arbitrary-representative only through that definition (blocked_policy for a proof: change outside owned files). (7) Route: owned body and annex not yet input by handbook/parts/p02.tex and handbook/annex/p02.tex (blocked_policy: driver insertion by the lead). (8) Hodges 2001: blocked_source ACQ-2026-10-0433.
